mapper.select: SELECT id, name, code, icon, route_prefix, parent_id, sort_order, description, category, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM `module` ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, name, code, icon, route_prefix, parent_id, sort_order, description, category, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM `module` WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT m.id, m.name, m.code, m.icon, m.route_prefix, m.parent_id, m.sort_order, m.description, m.category, m.enabled, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM `module` m INNER JOIN role_module rm ON rm.module_id = m.id WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId} AND m.enabled = 1 ORDER BY m.sort_order ASC, m.id ASC

SELECT id, name, code, icon, route_prefix, parent_id, sort_order, description, category, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM `module` WHERE category = #{category} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, name, code, icon, route_prefix, parent_id, sort_order, description, category, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM `module`
WHERE parent_id = #{parentId}
WHERE parent_id IS NULL
ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `module` (name, code, icon, route_prefix, parent_id, sort_order, description, category, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{code}, #{icon}, #{routePrefix}, #{parentId}, #{sortOrder}, #{description}, #{category}, #{enabled}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE `module` SET sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
